Package com.hkust.marketplace.models

Class Offer

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.models.Offer
Direct Known Subclasses:
BorrowRequest, Claim, PriceOffer
public abstract class Offer extends Object
A buyer's action on a listing (Offer in the domain class diagram), called a "deal" in the use cases. Every offer is exactly one of PriceOffer, BorrowRequest or Claim ({complete, disjoint}). An offer belongs to the chat thread between its buyer and its listing (UC5 step 7). The status changes only through the methods below, which enforce:
  • only a Pending offer can be accepted or countered (Manage Offers & Requests);
  • a Pending or Countered offer can be declined (UC7 Special Requirement 5);
  • only an Accepted offer can be completed, and only once (UC7 Special Requirement 1);
  • {acceptedDate and completedDate can only be set if status = Accepted}.
